column1: # N-1 expected pin failures (HEAAA-739 Q1 (d), amends HEAAA-722 D2). A previous-release test that asserts the literal size of the
# definer catalog is RUN; check-junit.mjs accepts its failure only as exactly this assertion (strictEqual, expected = the literal,
# actual = the candidate catalog size, first stack frame = path:line). Anything else, or the test passing, fails N-1. A pin is "not a pass".
# No behavioural, RLS, grant-refusal or audit assertion may be the recorded pin. Columns (TAB): suite, exact test name, path:line, literal, reason.

# Candidate tests carrying the same assertions that must pass in the fresh-database stage: T-RA-29 -> candidate "T-RA-29: catalog"; I-10 -> candidate I-10 and messaging T-9; T2 -> none (nothing follows the pin).
